title: Bill 105 rebuilding nonconforming structures after disasters
summary: On July 19, 2024, the council sent Bill 105, which deals with nonconformities, to its Housing and Land Use Committee. A testifier said Bills 87, 105 and 110 would help provide temporary housing.

upcomingEvent.what: The draft gives properties affected by the August 2023 Maui wildfires until April 1, 2029, to rebuild or restart uses.

timeline.text: Bill 105 passed final reading nine to zero.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The vice chair withdrew the proposed change after the discussion.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The attorney said vacation rentals will not get the extra time, except owner-occupied units.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: An attorney said that under current law, a nonconforming use is lost after 12 straight months without it.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A county attorney said the change would likely not be a taking but was unsure why that date was chosen.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A member said hundreds of people lack places to live and the eviction moratorium has been lifted.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A member said the need is for housing for residents, not vacation rentals.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The vice chair proposed changing Bill 105 to protect uses the county had confirmed in writing as nonconforming before a date in 2015.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A sponsor said the bill will let people with permits waiting at the Planning Department move forward and help the community rebuild.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The chair said first reading is likely March 7th, with second reading March 21st.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The committee voted to recommend passing the bill as amended.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members unanimously approved replacing the bill with the amended committee draft.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The committee draft extends the rebuilding deadline for wildfire-affected nonconforming properties to April 1st, 2029.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said most cases will likely involve setbacks, the required distance from property lines.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair said March 21 is the target date for the bill to pass second reading.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair said some owners are waiting to draw plans until the bill passes because each change to plans costs money.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Another change lets the fire chief require a nonconforming use to move to a more suitable part of a lot or building.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: One proposed change lets the fire chief require rebuilt homes to meet two code sections ordinarily required of commercial buildings.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The committee took up Bill 105-2024 on nonconformities, meaning buildings or uses that don't meet current zoning rules.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said owners would still go through the normal building permit process.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said nonconforming structures and uses are technically already lost under the existing rules' time limits.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: A testifier for Airbnb urged the committee to strike a proposed amendment on short-term rentals.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: A Front Street building's co-managing partner said the current 12-month limit is impossible to meet after the disaster.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said the Molokaʻi Planning Commission recommended that the bill exclude Molokaʻi.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said the Lānaʻi and Maui Planning Commissions both recommended approval.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The bill gives five years to finish building permits, with a possible two-year extension by the director.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said current code would not let nonconforming uses come back, because more than 12 months have passed since the August 2023 disaster.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Bill 105 is a Planning Department proposal for nonconforming structures and uses (ones that break today's zoning rules) hit by an emergency or disaster.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The committee had two items: Bill 105 (2024) on nonconformities, and Housing Solutions.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Committee staff said they are waiting for the Planning Department to answer questions about Bill 105.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Referral of Bill 105 (nonconformities): The council sent Bill 105 to the Housing and Land Use Committee.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Another testifier said Bills 87, 105 and 110 would help provide temporary housing.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting
